notes: This fresh, independent review session did not implement T9. No agents were delegated implementation work. The only repository file created by this session is this T9.json review. Tests, reviewer probe files, and all mutations ran only in the exported temporary snapshot; no Git index or ref changes and no rm commands were performed.

Review target is the immutable full-SHA diff, including the committed product code used to evaluate its tests. Concurrent working-tree changes observed near the end do not change this verdict's target.

Hook isolation: backend/tests/qa_hooks/channel_expansion_qa.py:67-69 registers only when DCX_TEST_ADAPTER_MODULE equals its module name. Explicit imports with the variable absent or selecting another module leave REGISTRY unchanged. No product module imports channel_expansion_qa. app/crawl/worker.py:49-52 loads the selected module only when run_list or run_detail executes; control._spawn launches separate worker processes with inherited environment.

Offline behavior and exact data: the hook uses local deterministic construction and urllib.parse only. Per nonempty keyword it returns youtube_vlog=6, threads=25, naver_kin=5, cook82=8; vlog positions 3 and 6 skip no_ko_captions, Kin position 5 skips deleted; qa-empty returns zero for all four. URL-encoded keyword queries survive normalization on qa.invalid and keep distinct keywords from collapsing into the same URLs. QA_THREADS_MODE=blocked affects only Threads detail fetch and raises AdapterBlocked with host threads.com.

Worker contract: list_page accepts keyword, cursor, and **options, including videos_per_keyword/min_duration_s/max_duration_s. The fixed QA inventory is intentional; the worker still applies configured caps. fetch accepts a ListItem. FetchedDoc is constructed with named fields matching the real dataclass, including public access, author_raw, and thread_key. Vlog emits distinct 0-90 and 90-180 thread keys and segmenter=embedding. All 90 full documents survived the worker's Doc validation, writer/readback, explicit Doc.model_validate, and preprocessing; authors were hashed.

API availability / QA-NEG-002: the subprocess probe imported app.main under the QA environment and verified REGISTRY['threads'] remained ThreadsAdapter, the QA module was absent, and an empty PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH removed Threads from real available_sources and status settings. Config save rejected Threads with 422. app/routers/crawl_v2.py:31 and its error handler map this rejection to sources_unavailable. The hook's intentionally minimal worker adapters do not interfere with API class availability.

Registry restoration: test_qa_hook.py:35-41 records all originals with monkeypatch before import-time registration, removes the cached module, and lets fixture teardown restore the originals. The complete crawl suite passed in one process. Forward hook-before-real-adapter tests passed, and a reversed 33-test run explicitly verified the full original REGISTRY and cleared hook module after every teardown.

Flow assertions: test_channel_expansion_flow.py:77-93 checks per-source document counts, expected ID prefix set, full fetch levels, preprocessing retention and desc/link compatibility, exact 1032-dimensional input, zero values in the five legacy channel indicator columns, detail state, and exclusion of intentional skips from attempt counts.
